explanation: The English article on the treaty names the parties, agreements "between Italy under King Victor Emmanuel III and Duce Benito Mussolini and the Holy See under Pope Pius XI to settle the long-standing Roman question". The article on the march says the march is what put Mussolini there. The demonstration of October 1922 "resulted in Benito Mussolini’s National Fascist Party ascending to power in the Kingdom of Italy", and the King appointed him Prime Minister on 30 October. The Roman question is older than both records. The march supplied the government that settled it.
